Perphenazine has also been given by slow infusion. The long-acting decanoate or enantate esters of per- phenazine are given by deep intramuscular injection in doses ranging from about 50 to 300 mg of ester given at intervals of 2 to 4 weeks. Perphenazine and its esters should be given in reduced doses to the elderly but it should be noted that they are not indicated for the management of agitation and rest- lessness in these patients. ◊ References. 1.
